description:
Coffee brewing assistant with timer, bean management, and tasting notes

Brew Guide is an all-in-one coffee brewing assistant app.
Features include brewing timer with multi-stage guidance, coffee bean inventory management,
brewing notes with ratings and flavor profiles, and cloud sync support.
- Add manual coffee bean ordering and weekly statistics and filters.
- Restore note duplication and improve brewing parameter editing and saving.
- Improve cloud sync, backup imports, inventory precision, and image handling.
- Fix startup failures on older Android devices and stale UI after Windows upgrades.
- Improve startup and synchronization error diagnostics.
